verdict.rationale: The YubiKey is a hardware key, but Yubico also runs a YubiEnterprise service with a public REST API for fleet delivery, inventory and shipment management (yubikey-probe-rt-2). Event subscription is a plausible capability for that service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows webhooks or any other event-subscription mechanism; the documented surfaces are only a pull-style REST API, the ykman CLI and on-device SDKs.
